how_the_words_were_read: 'authorize phase 1a' answers the assistant's recommendation to say exactly that. It authorizes Phase 1a of docs/M5-ADVANCED-MODELS-SCOPE.md as the proposal words it: an availability probe (no acquisition into the dataset): which regime and market-structure fields can be had point-in-time and under the provider's terms.

The probe is described before it runs. A spec (config/m5-phase1a-probe-spec.json) fixes the symbols, windows and checks and is committed before the probe is run; a standard-library probe module reuses the project's reviewed Alpaca access pattern (nre/alpaca_probe.py, nre/event_acquire.py); tests run offline. The findings are reported against the spec as written.

What it may read: the Alpaca market-data API (daily bars, a short minute-bar sample on ordinary sessions away from candidate earnings dates, and the corporate-actions endpoint) for the pre-specified symbols, through GitHub Actions with the repository's existing secrets; the public documentation of Alpaca, SEC, FINRA and CBOE as primary sources for the fields Alpaca does not provide; and SEC EDGAR, a provider the project already uses, to see which issuers' filings carry shares-outstanding and public-float facts. It keeps only availability metadata: dates, counts, status codes and ratios.
Nothing is bought, no provider the project has not reviewed has its data fetched, and no event, label, feature or price is added to the dataset or committed.
Running the probe needs its workflow pushed to GitHub. The words do not carry a push: the assistant commits locally and waits for the owner's word "push", as in every earlier step.
The go-ahead follows the order proposed in docs/M5-ADVANCED-MODELS-SCOPE.md section 3 (1a first). It does not authorize 1b, 0, 1c or any later phase.

Disclosure: the daily-bar requests cover the 23 issuers over the study span, whose event days lie inside it. The probe keeps only each bar's date and a count of zero-volume bars, computes no return, label or feature, and a test checks that its report holds no price or volume value. The minute-bar sample uses sessions the candidate ledgers show to be away from any candidate date.
authorized_under_these_words: The probe spec, the probe module, its tests and its GitHub Actions workflow, built and committed locally.
Running the probe on GitHub Actions once the owner has said "push", and reading its result from the run.
Reading primary-source documentation (Alpaca, SEC, FINRA, CBOE) and a bounded SEC EDGAR availability check for the 23 issuers, for the fields Alpaca does not provide.
A findings record and a findings document stating, field by field from the master prompt's sections 10 and 11, what can be had point-in-time and under which terms.
not_authorized_by_these_words: Phase 1b, enumerating or collecting any event since 2026-04-01, or Phase 1c, acquiring any derived feature for any event.
Phase 2, writing any Milestone 5 model, harness extension or leakage test; Phase 3, any development comparison; Phase 4, any look at a holdout.
Computing or storing any return, label, feature, price or volume value, or adding anything to the dataset.
Fetching data from a provider the project has not reviewed (for example FINRA or CBOE data files), or purchasing, licensing or signing up for anything.
Any read of a block-5 outcome, or any use of a Milestone 4 holdout result as an input to a Milestone 5 design choice.
Answering the provider-rights-at-scale question, which the proposal puts to the owner again before 1b or 1c.
Declaring Milestone 5 accepted, or starting Milestone 6 or any later milestone.
Any change to the accepted Milestone 4 work.
change_rule: If the probe shows that a confirmed default (reports/m5-scope-confirmation-2026-10-08.json) cannot be applied as written, the assistant stops at that point, records the finding and asks the owner; it does not change a confirmed default on its own.
not_a_claim: Not a start of Milestone 5 building beyond the probe, and not Milestone 5 acceptance.
Not a claim that any feature family will be used: the probe reports what can be had, and Phase 0 would decide what is pre-registered.
Not a claim about any market.
